_meta.title: Legal-basis register for the legislated-geographies map
_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for the AUTHORED legal characterisation of each geography type. These are interpretive claims (a reading of UK constitutional / local-government law) layered ON TOP of the SOURCED geography (names, GSS codes, ONS relationships). They are NOT fetched from a source. The UI reads from this file so the same claim is never restated (and cannot drift) across popups, the inspector and the Sources tab; and an expert can review the whole interpretive surface in one place (see each entry's `review`).

epistemic_key.sourced: comes from an official dataset/API (ONS, Natural England, …) — name, code, geometry, relationship lookups
epistemic_key.interpreted: authored legal characterisation — the law-type classification and the made-under-Act chain are our reading, not a fetched fact

_meta.dataset_driven_path: The `instruments` table grounds each SI/Order in its enabling Act as data (madeUnder, keyed by legislation.gov.uk IDs). Today every `madeUnder` is source:'authored'. legislation.gov.uk publishes each instrument's enabling power in its metadata (and the tna-legislation skill can fetch it), so these links can later be populated/verified automatically and flipped to source:'legislation.gov.uk'. The per-FEATURE link (which specific Order made THIS polygon) is not in the boundary data and stays type-level.

review.note: Whole register awaiting expert (constitutional / local-government law) review.

ssi/2020/344.note: Strategic Framework levels 0–4 by council area; enabling Act (Coronavirus Act 2020 / Public Health etc. (Scotland) Act 2008) needs confirming.

wsi/2020/1149.note: UNVERIFIED: wsi/2020/1149 resolves to a real Welsh COVID SI but the exact operative instrument on 2 Dec 2020 needs confirming; Wales ran national (non-area) rules.

constituencies.label: Westminster constituency
constituencies.claim: Drawn by the Parliamentary Constituencies Order 2023 (an Order in Council), made under the Parliamentary Constituencies Act 1986. NI's 18 double as the Northern Ireland Assembly constituencies.

senedd_const.label: Senedd (Welsh Parliament) constituency
senedd_const.claim: One of the 16 new Senedd constituencies (from May 2026), paired from Westminster constituencies by Order under the Government of Wales Act 2006 and the Senedd Cymru (Members and Elections) Act 2024.

spc.label: Scottish Parliament constituency
spc.claim: A Holyrood constituency, drawn by Order on a Boundaries Scotland review under the Scotland Act 1998.

spr.label: Scottish Parliament region
spr.claim: A Holyrood additional-member region (tops up the constituency seats), drawn by Order on a Boundaries Scotland review under the Scotland Act 1998.

gla.label: London Assembly (GLA) constituency
gla.claim: A London Assembly constituency, under the Greater London Authority Act 1999 (powers devolved to the GLA).

lad.E.label: Local authority district (England)
lad.E.claim: Exists under the Local Government Act 1972 (primary); the specific districts were constituted and named by Orders under it (e.g. the English Non-metropolitan Districts (Names) Order 1973). Electoral WARDS are a separate matter (LGBCE under the LDEDC Act 2009).

review.note: Conflation with LDEDCA 2009 corrected; wards separated out.

lad.london.label: London borough
lad.london.claim: The 32 London boroughs were created by the London Government Act 1963 (primary); the GLA by the Greater London Authority Act 1999. Later boundary changes by Order.

lad.W.label: Welsh principal area
lad.W.claim: A Welsh principal area, created by the Local Government (Wales) Act 1994; boundary changes by Order under it.

lad.S.label: Scottish council area
lad.S.claim: A Scottish council area, created by the Local Government etc. (Scotland) Act 1994; boundary changes by Order under it.

lad.N.label: Northern Ireland local government district
lad.N.claim: One of Northern Ireland's 11 districts, established by the Local Government Act (Northern Ireland) 2014 (replaced the former 26).

ward.E.label: Electoral ward (England)
ward.E.body: Local Government Boundary Commission for England
ward.E.claim: Drawn by an Electoral Changes Order (an SI) made by the LGBC for England under the Local Democracy, Economic Development and Construction Act 2009.

review.note: Current 2024 boundaries; later reviews may revise.

ward.S.label: Electoral ward (Scotland)
ward.S.claim: Drawn by Order on a Boundaries Scotland review under the Local Government (Scotland) Act 1973.

review.note: Nation-awareness corrected (was citing the England chain).

ward.W.label: Electoral ward (Wales)
ward.W.body: Local Democracy & Boundary Commission for Wales
ward.W.claim: Drawn by Order on a review by the Local Democracy & Boundary Commission for Wales under the Local Government (Democracy) (Wales) Act 2013.

ward.N.label: Electoral ward (Northern Ireland)
ward.N.claim: Drawn by Order on a review by the Local Government Boundaries Commissioner for Northern Ireland under the Local Government Act (NI) 2014.

parish.E.label: Civil parish (England)
parish.E.claim: Created/altered by Order following a community governance review under the Local Government and Public Involvement in Health Act 2007, Part 4.

parish.W.label: Community (Wales)
parish.W.claim: A Welsh community (the equivalent of a parish), created by Order under the Local Government Act 1972; boundaries reviewed under the Local Government (Democracy) (Wales) Act 2013.

combined_auth.label: Combined authority / mayoralty
combined_auth.claim: A (mayoral) combined authority, established by a bespoke Order (SI) under the Local Democracy, Economic Development and Construction Act 2009 and the Cities and Local Government Devolution Act 2016.

national_parks.EW.label: National Park (England/Wales)
national_parks.EW.claim: A National Park designated by order under the National Parks and Access to the Countryside Act 1949 (confirmed by the relevant designation/variation order).

national_parks.S.label: National Park (Scotland)
national_parks.S.claim: A Scottish National Park designated by order under the National Parks (Scotland) Act 2000.

aonb.EW.label: AONB / National Landscape (England/Wales)
aonb.EW.claim: Designated as an Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty by order; designation procedure under Part IV of the Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000 (older AONBs under the NPACA 1949).

aonb.N.label: AONB (Northern Ireland)
aonb.N.claim: A Northern Ireland AONB, made by DAERA under the Nature Conservation and Amenity Lands (Northern Ireland) Order 1985.

nsa.S.label: National Scenic Area (Scotland)
nsa.S.claim: Scotland's analogue of an AONB; the 40 National Scenic Areas have statutory footing under the Planning etc. (Scotland) Act 2006.

mpa.E.label: Marine Conservation Zone (England)
mpa.E.claim: Designated by the named MCZ Designation Order under s.116 of the Marine and Coastal Access Act 2009.

mpa.W.label: Marine Conservation Zone (Wales)
mpa.W.claim: A Welsh MCZ designated by order of the Welsh Ministers under the Marine and Coastal Access Act 2009 (Skomer is currently Wales's only MCZ).

mpa.N.label: Marine Conservation Zone (Northern Ireland)
mpa.N.claim: A NI MCZ designated by DAERA under the Marine Act (Northern Ireland) 2013.

mpa.S.label: Nature Conservation MPA (Scotland)
mpa.S.claim: A Scottish Nature Conservation Marine Protected Area, made by designation order under the Marine (Scotland) Act 2010 (territorial waters; offshore MPAs use the Marine and Coastal Access Act 2009).

sssi.label: SSSI
sssi.claim: Notified by Natural England under the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981, s.28 — a statutory notification under a primary Act (NOT a statutory instrument).

sac.label: Special Area of Conservation
sac.claim: Designated under the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017 (SI 2017/1012) — secondary legislation — historically made under the European Communities Act 1972 (now assimilated law).

review.note: ECA 1972 repealed; current footing needs review.

spa.label: Special Protection Area
spa.claim: Classified for wild birds under the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017 (SI 2017/1012) — the same Habitats Regs chain as SACs.

review.note: ECA 1972 repealed; current footing needs review.

ramsar.label: Ramsar site
ramsar.claim: An international designation (Ramsar Convention 1971); protected in domestic law as if an SSSI — NOT itself made by a UK statutory instrument.

nnr.label: National Nature Reserve
nnr.claim: Declared by Natural England under the National Parks and Access to the Countryside Act 1949 / Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981 (primary).

lnr.label: Local Nature Reserve
lnr.claim: Declared by the local authority under the National Parks and Access to the Countryside Act 1949, s.21 (primary).

covid.E.label: COVID-19 tier (England)
covid.E.claim: England tier on 2 Dec 2020, set by Schedule 4 of the Health Protection (Coronavirus, Restrictions) (All Tiers) (England) Regulations 2020, made under the Public Health (Control of Disease) Act 1984.

covid.S.label: COVID-19 protection level (Scotland)
covid.S.claim: Scotland Strategic Framework protection level (0–4) by council on 2 Dec 2020, under the Local Levels Regulations (SSI 2020/344).

review.note: Enabling Act (Coronavirus Act 2020 vs Public Health etc. (Scotland) Act 2008) needs confirming.

covid.WN.label: COVID-19 regime (Wales / NI)
covid.WN.claim: On 2 Dec 2020 Wales and NI ran national (non-area) regimes under their own regulations — shown as a single national fill, not a per-area choropleth.

review.note: Exact Welsh/NI instruments not pinned (wsi/2020/1149 unverified).
